name: Kiro CLI

file.name: agent-monitor
file.description: Kiro's tools, with agent-monitor (am) hooks that report this session's status to the am dashboard.

notes: Kiro runs these hooks only in its agent-monitor agent: start it with `kiro-cli chat --agent agent-monitor` (am does when it starts or resumes Kiro), or make it the default with `kiro-cli settings chat.defaultAgent agent-monitor`. Kiro has no permission hook, so it never shows waiting
